title: The inverse image of abelian sheaves along a morphism of sites is exact
statement: Let $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be a morphism of sites given by the continuous functor $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (3), and let $f^{-1}=u_s:\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ be the inverse image on abelian sheaves, the left adjoint of $f_*=u^s$ on abelian sheaves. Then $f^{-1}$ is an additive functor which commutes with finite limits and finite colimits of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$; in particular it carries kernels and cokernels to kernels and cokernels, short exact sequences $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal E\to0$ of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ to short exact sequences of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$, and every exact sequence (finite or infinite, e.g. $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal I^0\to\mathcal I^1\to\cdots$) to an exact sequence.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma Tag 04JC (lemma-flat-pullback-exact), first assertion and the first paragraph of its proof (the underlying sheaf of sets of the abelian f^{-1}G is the set-theoretic f^{-1} of the underlying sheaf of sets, Sites Section Tag 00YR, so exactness of f^{-1} on sheaves of sets gives exactness on abelian sheaves); stated there for a morphism of topoi, which a morphism of sites induces (Sites, Lemma Tag 00XC, lemma-morphism-sites-topoi); Lemma Tag 03DC (lemma-exactness-pushforward-pullback) for the colimits (left adjoint)
